C4_d1_closure.a5_formula_verbatim: a5_lane/proposal_1.json incremental_test.operationalization reads: 'overall incremental alpha := (full-sample sum of the anchor's after-cost financing-adjusted per-pair-day PnL) - (same for the benchmark), both normalized per pair-day of the identical post-warmup schedule window, with identical notional units per active position. Gate: > 0. The per-trade expectancy difference (anchor - benchmark) is reported alongside as a diagnostic, not the gate.' The implemented formula is round((fsum(anchor financing-adjusted pnls) - fsum(benchmark financing-adjusted pnls)) / post_warmup_pair_days(...), 10); (sumA/N) - (sumB/N) == (sumA - sumB)/N over the SAME N, and N is the pair-day count of the identical post-warmup schedule window (per pair: the authorized snapshot's daily 16:00-NY decision bars minus the family's frozen warmup prefix, summed over the frozen universe PAIRS tuple; 63-bar anchor warmup is the deeper of the two warmups, hence the common post-warmup window for anchor and benchmark alike). The in-code transcription quotes the proposal text verbatim. Identical notional holds: both books book through the same kernel at the same frozen unit notional.
